featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 新增 NSH 第三框架，按平台能力完成桌面、Android、iOS、Web 初始化及共享 Rust core 接线。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Add NSH alongside Tauri and GPUI, with platform-aware initialization and shared Rust core wiring for desktop, Android, iOS and Web.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 新增 NSH 本地与候选打包、版本同步、发布元数据及按框架裁剪的升级支持。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Add dedicated NSH local and candidate packaging, version synchronization, release metadata, and framework-specific upgrade pruning.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 处理 iOS 可执行文件与资源目录重名，生成同时兼容 Android 和 Apple 的应用标识。
bugFixes.en-US: Prevent iOS executable and resource name collisions, and generate application identifiers accepted by both Android and Apple.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 在写入工作区前格式化生成的 Rust，并补齐框架元数据的 NSH 文档声明。
bugFixes.en-US: Format generated Rust before writing the workspace and include NSH in the documented GUI framework values.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 下游升级首次确认并记忆退役工程资产的清理或保留选择。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Remember each downstream project’s confirmed choice to remove or preserve retired engineering assets.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 发现旧来源锁未登记的退役文件；清理未完成时拒绝记录升级完成。
bugFixes.en-US: Detect retired files absent from legacy source locks and prevent upgrades from being recorded as complete before cleanup finishes.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 清除退役更新、统计执行合同和远程追踪依赖候选，保留历史验证事实。
bugFixes.en-US: Remove retired update and statistics execution contracts and remote tracing dependency candidates while preserving historical verification facts.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 补充 GPUI Kit 0.9.0 的 API、依赖与 vendor 联合迁移参考，并接入工程索引。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Add GPUI Kit 0.9.0 references for APIs, dependencies, and coordinated vendor migrations to the engineering index.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 公开 Windows 开发循环的后代进程回收限制，明确后续原生验证条件。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Document descendant process cleanup limitations in the Windows development loop and the conditions for native verification.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 对齐中性初始化后的产品定义与接口复用顺序，移除升级和技术债流程中强制创建 Todo 的旧描述。
bugFixes.en-US: Align product definition and interface reuse with neutral initialization, and remove outdated mandatory Todo wording from upgrade and technical debt workflows.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修正 Dialog 几何观察说明，区分 ElementId 路径与 debug selector。
bugFixes.en-US: Correct Dialog geometry guidance by distinguishing ElementId paths from debug selectors.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 移除应用更新、强更与使用统计的模板能力、支持资产和候选门禁；保留权威版本、本地双语发布日志及既有下游实现保护。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Removed app update, mandatory update and usage telemetry scaffolding, support assets and candidate gates; retained authoritative versions, local bilingual release notes and protection for existing downstream implementations.

bugFixes.zh-CN: GPUI 写入前要求明确确认平台、能力、页面及侧栏，拒绝漏答和歧义关于页配置，避免未经确认生成内容。
bugFixes.en-US: Require explicit confirmation of GPUI platforms, capabilities, pages and sidebar before writes, rejecting missing selections and ambiguous About page profiles.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 三平台 CLI 候选流程严格核对持久接口与完整平台集合，在测试或构建前拒绝非法、重复或缺失选择。
bugFixes.en-US: Validate persisted interfaces and the complete platform set for three-platform CLI candidates, rejecting invalid, duplicate or missing selections before tests or builds.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 统一 CLI 默认选择、Tauri/GPUI 运行时与测试分流及工程记忆描述，清理退役统计条款和过期授权表述。
bugFixes.en-US: Aligned CLI default selection, Tauri/GPUI runtime and test routing, and engineering records; removed retired telemetry clauses and stale authorization wording.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 新增技术文档提取 Skill，以 knowledge 概览统一技术选型、依赖、架构、文件结构和技术债，并生成可交互架构图。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Added a technical-documentation skill with a knowledge overview covering technology choices, dependencies, architecture, file structure and technical debt, plus an interactive architecture diagram.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 支持项目本地 Archify 按需安装，所有接口保留知识提取入口，初始化和升级保护本地知识产物。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Added on-demand project-local Archify installation, retained the extraction skill for all interfaces, and protected local knowledge artifacts during initialization and upgrades.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复 GPUI 知识安装误读 TOML 多行文本以及接受未知或重复接口的问题。
bugFixes.en-US: Fixed GPUI knowledge installation incorrectly reading multiline TOML text and accepting unknown or duplicate interfaces.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 升级来源锁在最终替换前复核计划快照，避免覆盖预检后并发创建或改写的内容。
bugFixes.en-US: Rechecked the planned upstream-lock snapshot immediately before replacement to preserve concurrent creations and edits made after preflight.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 补齐强更提示的可访问名称、描述关联和安全退出初始焦点。
bugFixes.en-US: Added an accessible name, description association and initial focus on the safe exit action to the mandatory-update prompt.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 本地品牌媒体路径拒绝控制字符，防止 URL 规范化绕过仅本地加载边界。
bugFixes.en-US: Rejected control characters in local brand-media paths to prevent URL normalization from bypassing local-only loading.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 统一候选收集与验收的审查源码绑定，并正确核对远端 release 分支与发布 tag。
bugFixes.en-US: Aligned collection and acceptance instructions with reviewed-source provenance checks and the remote release branch and release tag.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 统一 Tauri/GPUI 的 Windows exe 与 macOS dmg 安装包命名，包含程序展示名称、无 v 原始版本、归一架构与目标系统。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Use one naming format for Tauri and GPUI Windows EXE and macOS DMG installers, including the display name, raw version, normalized architecture and target OS.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 本地试包与发布候选共用命名逻辑，保留中文与空格，候选校验和及 manifest 同步引用最终文件名。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Share naming logic across local test packages and release candidates, preserve Chinese text and spaces, and keep candidate checksums and manifests aligned with the final filename.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 清理依赖管理、适配器、初始化和发布规则中对 nightly 与历史 Rust 工具链的要求，复用满足兼容下限的 stable，避免检查时重新安装额外版本。
bugFixes.en-US: Remove nightly and historical Rust toolchain requirements from dependency management, adapters, initialization and release rules; reuse a compatible stable toolchain so checks do not reinstall extra versions.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 候选 CI 改用 stable，将 Cargo MSRV 作为兼容下限核对实际 rustc/Cargo，并同步验证器和回归；当前 stable 通过不再被当作最低版本实测证据。
bugFixes.en-US: Use stable in candidate CI and validate the actual rustc/Cargo versions against the Cargo MSRV, with matching validators and regressions; passing on current stable no longer counts as a test of the minimum version.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 统一通用 Grid 规范及中性资产，支持无横滚列布局、单选/多选、跨页选择确认和完整值及行详情。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Unify generic Grid standards and neutral assets with layouts that avoid horizontal scrolling, single and multiple selection, cross-page query confirmation, full-value views and row details.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 集中系统中文字体回退、语义排版层级、等宽数字与亮暗主题文字 Token，并同步 Tauri/GPUI 设计规则。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Centralize system font fallbacks for Chinese, semantic typography, tabular numerals and light/dark text tokens, and synchronize Tauri and GPUI design rules.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 避免重复应用相同查询时重置页码和无效请求，限制重复重试，并在后台刷新及失败时保留内容与表格起点。
bugFixes.en-US: Avoid page resets and unnecessary requests when unchanged queries are reapplied, deduplicate retries, and retain content and the table start position during background refreshes and failures.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修正深色选中行辅助文字的对比度，并确保省略值按钮保留数据值作为可访问名称。
bugFixes.en-US: Correct secondary-text contrast on selected rows in the dark theme and preserve data values as accessible names for truncated-value buttons.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 更新并集中登记 68 个 Rust 库和 33 个前端包的兼容候选下界，同步中性资产、生成器与文档，并增加一致性门禁。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Update and centrally record compatible candidate minimums for 68 Rust crates and 33 frontend packages, synchronize neutral assets, generators and documentation, and add consistency checks.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 通用环境采用 Rust 1.95.0 与连续 Node.js 24.0.0 下界；Rust 门禁结合项目 Cargo MSRV，按较高下界检查和复探。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Use Rust 1.95.0 and continuous Node.js 24.0.0 as generic environment minimums; combine the Rust minimum with each project's Cargo MSRV and verify against the higher requirement.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 统一 Tauri 与 GPUI 的完整窗口标题，复用权威版本与语言状态，并补齐标题合同及生成资产回归。
bugFixes.en-US: Unify complete window titles in Tauri and GPUI using authoritative version and language state, with title contract checks and generated-asset regression coverage.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 为 TypeScript 依赖明确声明兼容上界，校验真实前端清单，避免安装超出 typescript-eslint peer 范围的版本。
bugFixes.en-US: Declare an explicit compatible upper bound for TypeScript and validate actual frontend manifests to prevent installation beyond the typescript-eslint peer range.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修正成功标准中的旧 Rust 下界表述，明确通用环境下界与中性模板 MSRV 1.98.1 的区别。
bugFixes.en-US: Correct the outdated Rust minimum in the success criteria and distinguish the generic environment minimum from the neutral template's MSRV of 1.98.1.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 将统一 UI 设计基座纳入受管标准，以 DESIGN.md 为导航，贯通初始化、日常实施和下游工程升级。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Add the unified UI foundation to managed standards, using DESIGN.md for navigation across initialization, daily implementation and downstream Harness upgrades.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: Tauri 与 GPUI 中性模板集中消费展示 Token，统一亮暗主题、侧栏和支持页；强调色随主题主色变化。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Make Tauri and GPUI neutral templates consume centralized presentation tokens for light and dark themes, sidebars and support pages, with accents following the theme primary color.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 退役 taste 自动安装和旧视觉硬锁，保留框架交互、列表数据合同、历史记录与既有下游自有资产保护。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Retire automatic taste installation and old visual constraints while preserving framework interactions, list data contracts, historical records and protection of existing downstream-owned assets.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 升级候选严格核对设计基座完整字节并保护项目自有 DESIGN.md；修正主色色板索引类型、侧栏旧尺寸断言及 GPUI Token 文档路径。
bugFixes.en-US: Validate complete design-foundation bytes in upgrade candidates while protecting project-owned DESIGN.md; fix primary-palette index typing, the outdated sidebar-size assertion and the documented GPUI token path.
